title: RunStarted
description: A run started for a signed intent. Topic hotl.run; subject and key: the run id. Producer: Orchestrator. Main consumers: Knowledge graph.

repos.description: The intent package's repo hints (repos before v0.12.0). The scope, not the hints, decides which repos the run may change (ScopeConfirmed, ADR 0018); empty when the package has no hints.
